beer.beer_description: Best Served is a brand new Imperial Pastry Stout, brewed to celebrate our Sixth Stout SZN release, inspired by the now ultra famous Biscoff biscuit. We kicked this decadent beauty off with a biscuit malt heavy stout base to keep the roast restrained and to let the additional flavours really shine. We then conditioned it on Speculoo’s Syrup, Cinnamon and spices to really bring those Biscoff notes. Pour this thick delight into your finest snifter and be met with a gorgeous slow cascading caramel tan head. On the nose those cinnamon and spice notes are really bursting through, followed by caramelised and fresh baked biscuits. Take a sip and you’ll be greeted with those same flavours up front, with some bakers chocolate sweetness and just a touch of roast to really round it all out. The finish is silky smooth, with a lingering clean roast finish to balance out the sweetness. Best served with 1 or 2 Biscoff’s (or maybe 3, we won’t judge).

items.badge_description: Thanks for staying at home, and checking in with Untappd! It allows us to stay connected to a community of beer lovers, just like you, even if we can't be in the same physical location. From our home to yours, cheers and stay safe!

You don't always intend to go for beers with a double digit ABV, but when you do, you make it count! Cheers to you, but be careful, 10% and up can really pack a punch. That's 15 different beers with an ABV of 10% and up. Try 5 more for Level 4!

Porters and Stouts are rich with both history and flavor. Roasty, dark, and delicious, these two styles helped start it all. That’s 150 different beers with the style of Porter or Stout. Try 5 more for Level 31!

Marshmallow, chocolate, apple pie! Cakes and cookies catch my eye. Churn that butter, twist and shout. Put it in a pastry stout! That’s 10 different beers with the style of Stout - Pastry, Stout - Imperial / Double Pastry, or Sour - Smoothie / Pastry. Check-in to 5 more to get to Level 3.
